# Faviens

> Agentic-AI consulting based in Zürich, Switzerland. Three groups of work:
> strategy and discovery, systems and applications, workshops and upskilling.
> Bilingual, German at the root and English under /en.

## Pronunciation

- English: FAY-vee-enz, /ˈfeɪviənz/
- German: FAH-vee-ens, /ˈfɑːviˌɛns/
